subject: Greetings from SST (Class S104)
snippet: Dear Parents of S104, Welcome to the 2019 school year at School of Science and Technology, Singapore! We are the Form Teachers of S104 and we are delighted to have your child, in our form class this
body_text:
Dear Parents of S104,



Welcome to the 2019 school year at School of Science and Technology,
Singapore!



We are the Form Teachers of S104 and we are delighted to have your child,
in our form class this year. Besides being your child’s form teachers, Mdm
Azizah will also be teaching him/her Character and Citizenship Education
(CCE).  I am also teaching the Higher Malay Language & Malay Language
students.  Mr Peh will be teaching Mathematics and Character and
Citizenship Education (CCE).



We are looking forward to an exciting year ahead. It is our goal to provide
all students with an educationally challenging, yet fun and enriching
experience in our classrooms. We have high expectations for your child and
we will do all that we can to help your child achieve those expectations.



Since attendance and appropriate behaviour at school are crucial to the
learning process, it is imperative that your child attends school every day
as a mature and responsible student.  During the first few weeks of school,
we will be working together with the students in S104 to develop a set of
code of conduct. Kindly note that the school’s code of conduct can be found
on the school’s website.



We would also like to take this opportunity to update you on the names and
contact details of the subject teachers teaching your child this year.  Do
feel free to contact them if you have any queries.  As Form Teachers, we do
want to extend our help in any way that we can.  As such, do CC us (Mdm
Azizah & Mr Peh) in the email correspondences.
